Umhumushi Wemibhalo Enezansi We-AI Wamahhala Womzamo

Leli ithuluzi lokuhumusha imibhalo engezansi ku-inthanethi elamahhala elinamandla amamodeli ezilimi ezinkulu. Layisha amafayela e-SRT, VTT noma e-ASS bese uhumusha imibhalo engezansi phakathi kwesiNgisi, isiShayina, isiJapane, isiKoria, isiPanishi, isiFulentshi nezinye izilimi ezingu-15+. Akukho ukubhalisa, akukho ukufakwa, akukho uphawu lwamanzi — livule kusiphequluli bese uqala ukuhumusha. Idatha yemibhalo engezansi ihlala kusiphequluli sakho ngaphandle uma unika amandla ukuhumusha kwamafu.

Izici ezibalulekile: ukuhlaziywa nokuhunyushwa kwe-AI kwe-SRT, VTT ne-ASS, ukuhlanganiswa kwemisho ehlakaniphile (lapho umusho owodwa ubandakanya imithetho eminingi, imithetho ihlanganiswa, ihunyushwe, bese ihlukaniswa futhi phezu komugqa wesikhathi wokuqala), ukuvumelanisa komugqa wesikhathi, ukugoqwa kwemigqa okuzenzakalelayo kombhalo we-CJK kanye nowaseNtshonalanga, ukususwa kwamagama agcwalisayo, ukusingathwa kwetemu yangokwezifiso, nezitayela zokuhumusha ezikhethekayo. Khipha amafayela ajwayelekile e-SRT, VTT, ASS noma TXT alungele ukubethela kanzima kuvidiyo yakho.

Ubani owusebenzisayo: abahumushi bamavidiyo, abadali beYouTube nabasebenzi bokuqondanisa, abafundi bezilimi, amaqembu emibhalo engezansi namaqembu adinga ukuqondanisa okuqukethwe kwevidiyo ngokushesha.
